lines.28: 「Hey, Otome... is it okay if I tell everyone we're dating?」
lines.29: 「We do live under the same roof.」
lines.31: 「It could be difficult to set a proper example.」
lines.32: 「We should keep it between our close friends. Not that I intend to hide it.」
lines.33: 「If anything, I want to go around bragging about you.」
lines.36: 「Being my little brother and my boyfriend will not earn you special treatment.」
lines.40: 「Can I make up for that by being spoiled now?」
lines.44: 「...We have an early morning tomorrow. Rest like this.」
lines.46: Otome held me close, wrapping me in her arms.
lines.47: Where did this overwhelming sense of safety come from?
lines.48: I drifted peacefully off to sleep.
